title: Pip and the Clockwork Mystery
logline: A curious elf boy awakens a magical mechanical owl to retrieve a floating key hidden deep within a secret attic library.

scenes.title: Behind the Forgotten Tapestry
scenes.narrative_text: Pip tiptoed up the spiral stairs. Behind a velvet curtain, he found a hidden door! It opened into a Secret Attic Library filled with endless shelves, floating dust motes, and leather-bound books that whispered softly in the warm breeze.

scenes.title: A Brass Friend Awakens
scenes.narrative_text: On an antique desk sat a quiet figure. It was a Clockwork Owl made of shiny copper gears! Pip gently turned the key on its back. Soft clicks filled the air as amber eyes glowed brightly. 'Hoot-click!' chirped the little owl.
